title: Fixed Bowed Jaws and Raised Lever Nail Clipper
description: One newly authored complete fixed nail-clipper-style exterior. Two whole bowed thin plates are connected by a finite rear joining bridge and terminate in opposed curved blunt lips with a real visible front gap. A whole retained vertical post occupies actual rectangular passages near the front; its transverse head retains a separate raised slotted operating lever with a small plain thumb inset. The long lever and two continuous jaw lips are not the old four-fork staple remover or a miniature desktop stapler. All geometry new, three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Static grooming-tool appearance only: lips remain finite and blunt, no finger, nail, cutting, trimming, lever travel, spring response, ergonomics, bodily use, manufacture or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
